origin.description: Trim whitespace without dropping ANSI styles.
origin.details: Trims ASCII whitespace and keeps the styles.

translation.description: Trim whitespace without dropping ANSI styles.
translation.details: Trims ASCII whitespace and keeps the styles.
translation.example:
from cli import ansi_trimws, col_red
from cli._options import options
options(**{"cli.num_colors": 8})
print(ansi_trimws("   " + col_red("I am red") + "   "))
